category: research testbed - distributed compute + 0.5-1 PB file storage

free_tier.stated: VMs up to 64 cores / 384 GB RAM with directly attached NVMe, GPUs, SmartNICs; 'large storage volumes'; facility holds 'between 1/2 and 1PB of file storage space' for experiment data, plus experiment-attached block storage

retention.stated: Bastion keys expire in 6 months, sliver keys in 2 years.

egress.terms: free; on-demand 25-100 Gbps inter-site links, public IPv4/IPv6 peering, Internet2 100 Gbps cloud peering

interface_detail: fablib Python API, JupyterHub, portal; ssh via bastion.fabric-testbed.net
tooling: fablib, FABRIC CLI, Jupyter notebooks with preloaded tokens
chaining: slice with NVMe + block storage; the management plane is explicitly not a data path
limits_note: Slices have 'a finite lifetime, but can typically be extended before they expire'. Management plane is rate-limited to ~1 Gbps and 'has traffic filtering rules to prevent hosting Internet-facing services' - so you cannot serve from the control network, only from experiment links. Identity is CILogon/InCommon R&S, i.e. an institutional IdP. Bastion keys expire in 6 months, sliver keys in 2 years.
reliability_note: Explicitly 'experimental and no production'; not expected to provide production-grade reliability.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
